title: Two weight-loss drugs are now worth hundreds of billions

beats.narration: A handful of weight-loss drugs just turned two drugmakers into some of the biggest companies on Earth.
Eli Lilly's Zepbound and Mounjaro made it one of the most valuable companies in the world.
But Lilly didn't start this race.
Novo Nordisk did, with Ozempic and Wegovy — the shots that turned weight loss into a blockbuster.
For a while, Novo was the most valuable company in all of Europe.
Now Lilly's newer drug works even better in trials, and the lead is shifting fast.
A two-company race worth hundreds of billions. Follow for more.
